newsitem.title: UK: Abbey National says no plans to buy insurer.
newsitem.headline: Abbey National says no plans to buy insurer.

text.p: British bank Abbey National Plc, which this week failed in its bid to take over insurance group Scottish Amicable, said it had no plans at present to buy another life company.

"We have made it clear that we want to grow our life assurance operation organically -- we would only consider an acquisition with an appropriate partner if the price were right and the acquisition therefore created value for our shareholders," Abbey National said in a statement.

Scottish Amicable confirmed earlier on Tuesday that Prudential Corp Plc had won the race to become the the preferred bidder for the group, beating Abbey National and Australian Mutual Provident (AMP).
